title: bugbot workspace
description: workspace.json, written by `bugbot setup`: which repositories this machine reviews and which local clone is canonical for each. Personal (local paths and login), never shared.

github_user.description: gh login on the last setup run. Writes check the live login instead of trusting this.

org.description: Owner setup filtered by; null when every owner was offered.

repos.description: One entry per repository, keyed by owner/name.

clone_url.description: Normalized https URL; credentials are never stored.

remote.description: Remote pointing at the organization, preferably origin.

default_branch.description: From origin/HEAD, or from GitHub with --remote.

review_md.description: Reserved: path of the repository's REVIEW.md.

enabled.description: false keeps the entry but makes commands refuse the repository.
